title: A Cipher for the Alibi
author: O. M. Amberdale
blurb: Astrid Okafor, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
